dict.string: TinyMe listens while you hold the mic, so you can talk instead of type.
TinyMe reads your activity, workouts, body, sleep and heart data to fill your cards and answer your questions. It's sent only to your own TinyMe server.
TinyMe turns what you say into text on this phone. Your voice isn't sent anywhere.
TinyMe uses your location to find nearby places you ask about and to add the neighborhood to chat context. Your coordinates are not sent to the AI.
TinyMe uses your location in the background only when you enable nearby place alerts, so it can notify you when you pass a saved place.
TinyMe connects to your own server on this network.
